the purposes of comprehensive income disclosures, the Company does not record tax provisions or benefits for
the net changes in the foreign currency translation adjustment, as the Company intends to permanently reinvest
undistributed earnings of its foreign subsidiaries. Accumulated other comprehensive income is reported as a
component of stockholders’ equity and consisted of the following (in thousands):

The Company evaluates investments with unrealized losses to determine if the losses are other than
temporary. The Company has determined that the gross unrealized losses at December 31, 2007 are temporary. In
making this determination, the Company considered the financial condition and near-term prospects of the
issuers, the magnitude of the losses compared to the investments’ cost, the length of time the investments have
been in an unrealized loss position and the Company’s ability to hold the investments to maturity.
